hero.title: TikTok Downloader
hero.subtitle: Paste a TikTok link to download a video or photos.

form.label: TikTok video or photo link
form.help: Use a public TikTok video or photo link, including mobile share links.
form.credits: Loading details uses 1 credit; each video uses 2 credits and each photo uses 1 credit.
form.provider: Post IDs are sent to IGramAPI to retrieve media.

video.ready: Your video is ready. Tap Save video to download it.

photo.title: Photos
photo.label: Photo {index}
photo.ready: Photo {index} is ready. Tap Save photo to download it.

how.title: How to download a video
how.copyText: Open the video on TikTok, select Share, and copy its link.
how.pasteText: Paste the full video or photo link into the field above.
how.continueText: Download a video or choose photos to save.
